import copy,json,work

cases=[
 ({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},'current':{'a':{'hash':'y','kind':'file'},'b':{'hash':'x','kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),
 ({'declared':['missing'],'saved':{},'current':{}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
 ({'declared':['missing'],'saved':{'missing':{'kind':'missing'}},'current':{}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','meta':{'b':2,'a':1}}},'current':{'x':{'meta':{'a':1,'b':2},'kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'b'}}},{'ignored':['x']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})
]
for req,pol,want in cases:
 before=(copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)); got=work.evaluate(req,pol); assert got==want,(got,want); assert (req,pol)==before
requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); assert report==[work.evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
print('ok')

import copy,json,work

# Validate required behavior and output shape.
cases=[
 ({'declared':['z','a','z'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a','z']}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}},'current':{}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','name':'same','timestamp':1,'nested':{'b':2,'a':1}}},'current':{'x':{'nested':{'a':1,'b':2},'timestamp':2,'name':'same','kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']}),
 ({'declared':['x','y'],'saved':{'x':1,'y':1},'current':{'x':2,'y':2}},{'ignored':['x']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['y']}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':1,'irrelevant':1},'current':{'x':1,'irrelevant':2}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})
]
for req,pol,want in cases:
    req0,pol0=copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)
    got=work.evaluate(req,pol)
    assert got==want,(got,want)
    assert list(got)==['needs_review','changed']
    assert req==req0 and pol==pol0
schema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json'))
requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json'))
assert report==[work.evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
for result in report:
    assert set(result)==set(schema['required'])
    assert isinstance(result['needs_review'],bool) and isinstance(result['changed'],list)
print('all checks passed')
